2-byte length fields cap symbols and arity at 65,535. Corpus maxima: symbol 365 B, arity 10, longest atom encoding 1155 B -- headroom 179x. Overflow RAISES rather than truncating (encode True, node_hash True), so it is a liveness limit, never a silent collision. A single 64 KB string literal in a corpus would abort a commit.
